title: "Calculate lipid concentration and flux from traits"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2025-11-27"
output: html_document
---

This file is similar to the calculate_lipid_scape_flux_from_traits.Rmd but applies different mortality rate scenarios for calculating the total lipid flux.

Scenarios to check:
  1. High mortality: Visser et al. (2017) uses the mortality rate of 0.005 d-1. (higher mortality, stronger lipid pump)
  2. Winter activity: ~20% of surface population not diapausing
  3. Dynamic mortality: Reducing the respiration of the individuals that would have died

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# 1. Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# The calculated trait values
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260202.RData")

# <- Profiles metadata with regions and dataframe of volumes at 5m bins
load("data/UVP6_Calanus_metadata_20260129.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
source("functions/lipid_pump_toolkit.R")

clrs <- rev(c("blue","black","hotpink"))
```

## Organize the dataset to adjust for zeros
```{r, fig.height = 6}
# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins

# 1.1. In each 5m bin, per taxa, per profile, get abundance and biomass
df.5m <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance and biomass per bin
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
         biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
         structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
         waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
         respired_C_ugC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC),
         .groups = "drop") 
  
# 1.2. When calculating at 100 m bins, make sure to add the empty 5-m bins sampled but with no observed copepods
df.5m.zero <-  volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% indiv_traits$sample_id) %>% 
  # Repeat it 3 times for each taxa
  tidyr::crossing(taxa = c("Calanus", "Calanoida", "Copepoda")) %>% 
  select(-Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  left_join(df.5m, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, taxa)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) 

# 1.3. Calculate 100 m bin totals
df.100m <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per 100 m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mgC),
            respired_C_gC = sum(respired_C_ugC) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3 = respired_C_gC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass, multiple by number of 5m bins sampled
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins))
```

# 2. Baseline scenario beta = -0.001
```{r, fig.height = 6}
# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

# 2.1. Calculate the average diapause duration of the invididuals in a 100m bin to calculate the mortality  coefficient for that bin
mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
            nindiv = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_mean))

# 2.2. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m.base <- df.100m %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))

# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.base <- df.100m.base %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2)  / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")

# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region.base <- df.profile.base %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:frac_waxe_total,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "baseline")
```

# 3. Scenario 1: High mortality
## Calculate flux
Create a function instead to run different beta values
```{r}
vary_mortality <- function(beta, scenarioName) {
  
# 2.1. Calculate the average diapause duration of the invididuals in a 100m bin to calculate the mortality  coefficient for that bin
mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
            nindiv = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_mean))

# 2.2. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m <- df.100m %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))

# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile <- df.100m %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2)  / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")

# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region <- df.profile %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:frac_waxe_total,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = scenarioName,
         beta = beta) %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus")
  
  return(df.region)
}


```

### Sensitvity to mortality rates
```{r}
# Vary beta
df.mort.scens <- data.frame()
for (BB in c(0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.002, 0.003, 0.004, 0.005, 0.006)) {
  df <- vary_mortality(beta = BB*-1,
                       scenarioName = paste0("beta -", BB))
  
  df.mort.scens <- bind_rows(df.mort.scens, df)
}

comp.total <- df.mort.scens %>% 
  select(scenario, region.inuktitut, region,
         total_gC_flux_m2_mean) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario,
              values_from = total_gC_flux_m2_mean)

comp.frac <- df.mort.scens %>% 
  select(scenario, region.inuktitut, region,
         fraction_dead_mean) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario,
              values_from = fraction_dead_mean)

ggplot(df.mort.scens, aes(x = beta,
                       y = total_gC_flux_m2_mean,
                       color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.001) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color,
                     name = "Region") +

ggplot(df.mort.scens, aes(x = beta,
                       y = fraction_dead_mean,
                       color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.001) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color,
                     name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# 4. Scenario 2: Winter activity
```{r}
# For the population in upper 200 m*, exclude 20% from the mortality and respiration flux calculations by simply reducing abundance.
vary_winterActivity <- function(fracResident, scenarioName) {
  beta = -0.001

df.100m <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per 100 m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mgC),
            respired_C_gC = sum(respired_C_ugC) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3 = respired_C_gC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  
  
  # Here the abundance and biomass of the upper 200 m  population is reduced
  mutate(abundance_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                abundance_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                abundance_m3),
         biomass_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                biomass_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                biomass_mgC_m3),
         structural_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                structural_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                structural_mgC_m3),
         waxester_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                waxester_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                waxester_mgC_m3),
         respired_C_gC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                respired_C_gC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                respired_C_gC_m3)) %>% 
  
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass, multiple by number of 5m bins sampled
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins)) 
  
  
  # 2.1. Calculate the average diapause duration of the invididuals in a 100m bin to calculate the mortality  coefficient for that bin
mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
            nindiv = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_mean))

# 2.2. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m <- df.100m %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))

# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile <- df.100m %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2)  / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")

# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region <- df.profile %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:frac_waxe_total,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = scenarioName,
         fracResident = fracResident) %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus")
  
  return(df.region)
}


df.resi.scens <- data.frame()
for (WR in seq(0,0.5,0.1)) {
  df <- vary_winterActivity(fracResident = WR,
                       scenarioName = paste0("Winter Resident: ",WR*100,"%"))
  
  df.resi.scens <- bind_rows(df.resi.scens, df)
}


ggplot(df.resi.scens, aes(x = fracResident * 100,
                       y = total_gC_flux_m2_mean,
                       color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color,
                     name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  xlab("% winter residents")

# Relative to no winter residents, how does the total flux change?
comp.resi <- df.resi.scens %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, scenario,
         fracResident, 
         total_gC_flux_m2_mean) 

comp.resi <- comp.resi %>% 
  # establish the baseline
  left_join(comp.resi %>% 
              filter(fracResident == 0) %>% 
              select(region.inuktitut, baseline_flux = total_gC_flux_m2_mean),
            by = "region.inuktitut") %>% 
  # Calculate change in total flux and relative to the baseline
  mutate(tflux_change = total_gC_flux_m2_mean - baseline_flux, 
         tflux_change_base = (1 - total_gC_flux_m2_mean/baseline_flux)*-100)



ggplot(comp.resi, aes(x = fracResident * 100,
                       y = tflux_change_base,
                       color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color,
                     name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  xlab("% winter residents")
```

# 5. Scenario 3: Dynamic mortality
## Simple version: for the fraction dead, remove their contribution to respiration. Around 18% of respired C for beta = -0.001.

The result will be an average reduction of the total flux to 88% of the baseline scenario.
```{r}
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

# 1.1. In each 5m bin, per taxa, per profile, get abundance and biomass
df.5m <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance and biomass per bin
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
         biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
         structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
         waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
         respired_C_ugC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC),
         .groups = "drop") 
  
# 1.2. When calculating at 100 m bins, make sure to add the empty 5-m bins sampled but with no observed copepods
df.5m.zero <-  volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% indiv_traits$sample_id) %>% 
  # Repeat it 3 times for each taxa
  tidyr::crossing(taxa = c("Calanus", "Calanoida", "Copepoda")) %>% 
  select(-Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  left_join(df.5m, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, taxa)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) 

# 1.3. Calculate 100 m bin totals
df.100m <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per 100 m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mgC),
            respired_C_gC = sum(respired_C_ugC) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3 = respired_C_gC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass, multiple by number of 5m bins sampled
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins))

# 2.1. Calculate the average diapause duration of the invididuals in a 100m bin to calculate the mortality  coefficient for that bin
mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
            nindiv = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_mean))

# 2.2. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m.base <- df.100m %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000) %>% 
  # TODO remove the fraction that died from the respired C
  
  mutate(respired_C_gC_m2_prime = respired_C_gC_m2 * 
           (1 - (abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2) )) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
   mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_prime = respired_C_gC_m2_prime + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  
  # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))


# TODO --- SHOULD BE OKAY FROM HERE ON OUT ---
# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.base <- df.100m.base %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2)  / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_prime = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_prime),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")

# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region.base <- df.profile.base %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:fraction_dead,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "baseline") %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # change in total flux
  mutate(tflux_change = total_gC_flux_m2_prime_mean / total_gC_flux_m2_mean) %>% 
  relocate(tflux_change)

mean(df.region.base$tflux_change)
```


## Monthly reduction
This tries to recreate the monthly mortality calculation in Yang et al. (2025)

Start with 30-day time steps, calculate mortality, add that to the running structural and waxester mortality & also remove that fraction from the respiration rate

... This results in the same reduction in total flux as the simple method. So that would be: 88% of the baseline.
```{r}
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

# 1.1. In each 5m bin, per taxa, per profile, get abundance and biomass
df.5m <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance and biomass per bin
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
         biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
         structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
         waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
         respired_C_ugC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC),
         .groups = "drop") 
  
# 1.2. When calculating at 100 m bins, make sure to add the empty 5-m bins sampled but with no observed copepods
df.5m.zero <-  volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% indiv_traits$sample_id) %>% 
  # Repeat it 3 times for each taxa
  tidyr::crossing(taxa = c("Calanus", "Calanoida", "Copepoda")) %>% 
  select(-Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  left_join(df.5m, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, taxa)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) 

# 1.3. Calculate 100 m bin totals
df.100m <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per 100 m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mgC),
            respired_C_gC = sum(respired_C_ugC) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3 = respired_C_gC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass, multiple by number of 5m bins sampled
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins))



# TODO change this to 30 day intervals, calculate mortality, the remove that fraction from the respired C, and total biomass
df.100m.ts <- df.100m %>% 
  # establish the starting values
  mutate(orig_abundance_m2 = abundance_m2,
         orig_structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m2,
         orig_waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m2,
         orig_respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2,
         total_mort_abundance = 0,
         total_mort_structural = 0,
         total_mort_waxester = 0,
         total_mort_respiration = 0)
tstep <- 30
for (month in seq(1,8,1)) {
  mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
    mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
    mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                  240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
    group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
    summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
              diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
              nindiv = n(), 
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    
    # calculate how many days of diapause in this time step. If below the mean, do 30 days, if above the mean, get the remainder days or zero
    mutate(ndaysnow = month*tstep) %>% 
    mutate(diapause_dur_timestep = if_else(ndaysnow < diapause_dur_mean,
      tstep, 
      ndaysnow %% diapause_dur_mean)) %>% 
    mutate(diapause_dur_timestep = if_else(diapause_dur_timestep > 30,
                                           0, diapause_dur_timestep)) %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_timestep))  
  
# Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m.ts <- df.100m.ts %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_mgC_m2_mort = structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef),
         waxester_mgC_m2_mort = waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) %>% 
  # *** to remove the fraction that died from the respired C ***
  mutate(respiration_mort = respired_C_gC_m2 * 
           (abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2)) %>% 
  
  # The remaining population after mortality
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m2 - abundance_m2_mort,
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m2 - structural_mgC_m2_mort,
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m2 - waxester_mgC_m2_mort,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 - respiration_mort,
         
         total_mort_abundance = total_mort_abundance + abundance_m2_mort,
         total_mort_structural = total_mort_structural + structural_mgC_m2_mort,
         total_mort_waxester = total_mort_waxester + waxester_mgC_m2_mort,
         total_mort_respiration = total_mort_respiration + respiration_mort) %>% 
  select(-mortality.coef)
print(month)
  }


# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.base <- df.100m.ts %>% 
   # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  
  # Calculate respiration not affected by mortality and also convert mort to gC_m2 from mgC 
  mutate(respired_C_gC_m2_prime = orig_respired_C_gC_m2 - total_mort_respiration,
         structural_gC_m2_mort = total_mort_structural / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = total_mort_waxester / 1000) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = orig_respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort,
    total_gC_flux_m2_prime = respired_C_gC_m2_prime + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100))) %>% 

  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2)  / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(orig_respired_C_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2_prime = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_prime),
            total_mort_respiration = sum(total_mort_respiration),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_prime = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_prime),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")

# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region.base <- df.profile.base %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:fraction_dead,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "baseline") %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # change in total flux
  mutate(tflux_change = total_gC_flux_m2_prime_mean / total_gC_flux_m2_mean) %>% 
  relocate(tflux_change, total_gC_flux_m2_prime_mean, total_gC_flux_m2_mean,
           respired_C_gC_m2_mean, respired_C_gC_m2_prime_mean,
           total_mort_respiration_mean)

mean(df.region.base$tflux_change)
```

```{r, fig.height = 6, eval=FALSE}
# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
# TODO fix messy mgC and gC values
df.profile <- df.100m %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC) / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2_min = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_min),
            respired_C_gC_m2_max = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_max),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_min = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_min),
            total_gC_flux_m2_max = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_max),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause
  mutate(fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_min = total_gC_flux_m2_min / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_max = total_gC_flux_m2_max / biomass_gC_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")


# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region <- df.profile %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:fraction_C_flux_max,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

## Check range from respiration uncertainty
ggplot(df.profile %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
         aes(y = region.inuktitut)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
     # Add average values for the region
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_mean), shape = 17, size = 3, color = "black") +
    geom_linerange(data = df.region %>% 
                     filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
                   aes(xmin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean - total_gC_flux_m2_sd,
                       xmax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean + total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
                   color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,13,1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 8.5)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    xlab("Lipid pump carbon flux (gC m-2 y-1)") + ylab("Region") +
  # Add the min and max total flux 
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_min_mean), shape = 2, size = 3, color = "red") +
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_max_mean), shape = 2, size = 3, color = "red") +
  
  
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_min_median), shape = 4, size = 3, color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_max_median), shape = 4, size = 3, color = "black")


# ggsave("figures/Supp_fig5_total_flux_resp_uncertainty.png",
#        width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")


AA <- df.region %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, mean = fraction_C_flux_mean,
         min = fraction_C_flux_min_mean, max = fraction_C_flux_max_mean) %>% 
  mutate(min_diff = mean-min,
         max_diff = mean-max)
```
